paraphrases.text: Preserve separate reported precision: left FFA text p=.012 and table p=.01; right FFA text t=4.29 and table t=4.3. Bonferroni covers 12 regions; the reported raw-p threshold is .004. Table 1 z values belong to the localizer, not identity decoding.

paraphrases.locator: Materials and Methods / Participants; Experimental Design
paraphrases.text: 18 participants minus one excluded for movement; independently consistent with 14 participants completing five sessions plus three completing six sessions. Nine participants overlap an earlier publication; do not treat dependent reports as independent samples.

limitations: AI-assisted source inspection by Codex/root; human or expert review remains pending.
Only the listed minimal cells are available offline; complete articles and images are not retained.

AI-assisted primary-page reading, not human review.
Included17 is an explicit arithmetic derivation from the reported enrolment/exclusion, not a literal copied17 count.
